design.name: Rev E1 1.5 m solar-sail drone
design.revision_note: Rev E1 (14 Nov 2026): Rev E with part and firmware fixes after docs/Flooded_Stability.md and docs/Fatigue_Review.md: leak SAFE limit 1.0 kg (the sump holds about 1.2 L; was 1.5), tail boom 16 x 14 carbon (was 12 x 10; about +12 g, counterweight rebalanced automatically), steering wave filter (not modelled at this level). Plan: launched 45 km off Hatteras on the Gulf Stream edge, to Cornwall. Rev E (13 Nov 2026): Rev D plus a bilge pump with the pump-and-sail leak response, sealed rudder servos (Blue Trail SER-2000 enclosures with magnetic-encoder servos), a potted magnetic-encoder tail servo with a magnetic detent, deadband steering, a fin-to-bulb weed fairing and a weed-shedding manoeuvre; vents, a humidity sensor and a pressure-decay test port. A new letter because it adds a system (the pump) and a sensor. Servo and weed factors are guesses (docs/Reliability_Review.md). From Rev D (12 Nov 2026): limp-home controller, potted electronics, RockBLOCK Plus in the hatch lid, main GPS to the stern post. From Rev C: C5: wing 0.80 x 0.375 m (same area), 11 Nov 2026; C4: acetal mast bearings; C3: structural review changes (YB3 to the foredeck, fibreglass post and counterweight arm, servo-savers, 30 x 22 spar), 11 Nov 2026; C2: hardwood keel fin; C1: electronics box above the flood level
